description_good_justification: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury#readme` — the README opens with what the project is (audit-grade treasury close for crypto-first organizations) and the problem it solves (a defensible quarterly close an external auditor will sign, reproducible from hashed inputs).
interact_justification: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury#readme` — README covers obtaining the source (this repository; build with `cargo`), contact (office@), security reports (`SECURITY.md`), and contributing (`CONTRIBUTING.md`); issues at `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/issues`.
contribution_justification: URL: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md` — documents the fork → branch → PR flow against `main`.
contribution_requirements_justification: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#requirements-for-acceptable-contributions` — style, tests, security-change rules, dependency bar.
documentation_basics_justification: README (workspace map, structural guarantees, Development section with the build/test commands), `ARCHITECTURE.md`, the active spec `docs/treasury-suite-spec-v2.md`, the ADRs in `docs/adr/`, and `docs/auditor-evidence-guide.md`.
documentation_interface_justification: The external interface is the public Rust API, documented with `rustdoc` on every public item (`missing_docs` is a workspace lint; CI runs `cargo doc --workspace --no-deps`) and enumerated in `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/SEMVER.md#what-is-the-public-api`.
sites_https_justification: The project site is the GitHub repository (HTTPS). The project runs no other hosted site or service.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/issues` — searchable, URL-addressable, open, no proprietary client.
english_justification: All docs and issue handling in English.
maintained_justification: Release v0.22.0 (October 2026); commits on `main` through October 2026 (README and research-frame updates, Dependabot merges), CI and Dependabot active.
repo_interim_justification: Every change lands through a pull request from a pushed branch; interim work is visible between versions.
version_unique_justification: A single workspace version (`[workspace.package].version` in `Cargo.toml`) identifies each version; `CHANGELOG.md` records one entry per version.
version_semver_justification: URL: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/SEMVER.md` — Semantic Versioning with the documented pre-1.0 profile.
version_tags_justification: Releases are tagged `vX.Y.Z`, starting with the SSH-signed `v0.22.0` (`https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/releases/tag/v0.22.0`); versions up to 0.21.0 predate tagging, as `CHANGELOG.md` states.
release_notes_justification: URL: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md` — Keep a Changelog format, hand-written per version with a "why it matters" line, not VCS log output.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerability has been fixed in any version: no security advisories have been published for this repository.
report_responses_justification: Met by the documented process. No bug reports from outside the project have been received yet; the issues on file (#49, #62) were opened by the maintainer as tracked work.
enhancement_responses_justification: Met by the documented process. No enhancement requests from outside the project have been received yet; #49 (x402 decision-ref evidence ingestion) is a maintainer-filed enhancement tracked in the open.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: URL: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability` — private GitHub Security Advisory via the Security tab, or security@presidio-group.eu; acknowledgement within 72 hours.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports have been received in the last 6 months (no advisories, draft or published, exist for this repository).
build_justification: `cargo build --workspace` rebuilds everything from source; the toolchain is pinned in `rust-toolchain.toml`.
test_justification: Unit tests in every crate plus integration tests under `crates/*/tests/`: property tests (`proptest`), golden vectors cross-checked against an independent Python implementation, the `treasury-conformance` contract suites, and `treasury-e2e`, which runs the whole close twice. How to run: `CONTRIBUTING.md#local-verification`.
test_most_justification: CI enforces a 90% workspace line-coverage floor (`cargo llvm-cov --fail-under-lines 90`, `coverage` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`); measured 93.8% lines / 92.3% regions on 2026-10-25.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions on every push to `main` and every PR (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`): rustfmt, clippy, tests, docs, coverage, fuzz smoke, cargo-deny on Ubuntu with the pinned toolchain (1.88.0).
test_policy_justification: URL: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests` — functional changes ship with tests; fixes ship with regression tests.
tests_are_added_justification: Example: PR #37 (confirmation depth as a content-addressed `AnchorPolicy`, v0.22.0) shipped with `crates/treasury-anchor/tests/anchor_lifecycle.rs`, `anchoring_pipeline.rs`, the anchor-submitter conformance contract and an updated `treasury-e2e` golden close in the same change. PR #29 (agreed-reconciliation → L1 mapping) added `crates/treasury-chainsource/tests/observation_mapping.rs`.
tests_documented_added_justification: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests` states the policy that changes adding/modifying functionality ship with tests in the same PR.
warnings_justification: `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D clippy::all` and `cargo fmt --check` in CI; rustc warnings plus `missing_docs`.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails on any clippy finding; `main` is clean.
warnings_strict_justification: clippy `-D clippy::all` plus workspace denies on `unwrap_used`, `expect_used`, `panic`, `indexing_slicing`, `arithmetic_side_effects`, `float_arithmetic`; `unsafe_code` forbidden; `clippy::pedantic` as warnings. CI fails on any denied finding.
know_secure_design_justification: The design applies fail-closed gates throughout, least privilege (no keys, no network in the core), defence in depth (hash chain + external anchoring + dual control + replay-on-open), and makes dangerous states unconstructible. Argued in `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md#3-secure-design-principles-applied`; operator-in-scope threat model in `docs/threat-model.md`.
know_common_errors_justification: `docs/threat-model.md` (STRIDE per trust boundary) and `ASSURANCE.md#4-common-implementation-weaknesses-countered` map input validation, integer overflow, resource exhaustion, memory safety, crypto misuse, secrets and vulnerable dependencies to named countermeasures.
crypto_published_justification: SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) for content addressing and hash chaining; RFC 6962 Merkle tree hashing.
crypto_call_justification: SHA-256 comes from the RustCrypto `sha2` crate; no primitive is re-implemented.
crypto_keylength_justification: 256-bit digests. The project uses no keys.
crypto_working_justification: No MD4, MD5, single DES, RC4 or Dual_EC_DRBG anywhere in the codebase or its dependency graph.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The only cryptographic function is SHA-256 (plus RFC 6962 Merkle hashing over it); no MD5, SHA-1 or DES.
crypto_pfs_justification: The project implements no key-agreement or network protocol.
crypto_random_justification: The project generates no keys, nonces or other security-relevant random values. (`rand` appears only as a dev-dependency of `proptest`.)
delivery_mitm_justification: Distributed as source from GitHub over HTTPS/SSH only; no package-registry publishing.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash is fetched over plain HTTP.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No known unpatched medium+ vulnerabilities. `cargo-deny check all` (RustSec advisory database, yanked crates) is a required CI check; Dependabot security updates enabled.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability has arisen in the project or its dependencies; `cargo-deny` would fail CI on one.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: gitleaks 8.21.2 over the full history (all refs, 125 commits) on 2026-10-25: no leaks. GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled and has no alerts.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL for Rust and GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/codeql.yml`, results in GitHub code scanning) and clippy with the strict deny-list on every PR.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL for Rust and Actions (`https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml`) on every push/PR and weekly; clippy security-relevant denies (`arithmetic_side_effects`, `indexing_slicing`, `unwrap_used`); OpenSSF Scorecard weekly.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Findings are fixed before merge; CI blocks on clippy and cargo-deny findings.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and PR to `main`, plus a weekly scheduled run.
dynamic_analysis_justification: cargo-fuzz (libFuzzer) target `canonical_json` (`fuzz/`) feeds arbitrary bytes through JSON parsing and `treasury_evidence::canonical_bytes`, asserting no panic and that canonical output is a fixed point; runs 60 s on every PR (`fuzz` job). Property-based tests (`proptest`) cover the integer invariants.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Safe Rust only (`unsafe_code = "forbid"`); the cargo-fuzz target runs on every PR regardless.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests and fuzz targets are assertion-based; the fuzz build enables debug assertions, and release builds keep `overflow-checks = true`.
dco_justification: Every commit must carry a DCO `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`); enforced in review. Documented at `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#licensing-and-developer-certificate-of-origin-dco`. Inbound = outbound `MIT`.
governance_justification: Maintainer-led, single-steward model documented at `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md`: ordinary changes decided on the PR, security-relevant changes need a written rationale and may not weaken a default, API changes follow `SEMVER.md`, disagreements escalate to PRESIDIO Group.
roles_responsibilities_justification: Key roles (steward org, maintainer, security contact, release manager, contributor) documented at `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles-and-responsibilities`.
access_continuity_justification: Continuity rests on the steward organisation: the repository is owned by the `presidio-v` GitHub org, not a personal account; the project publishes no registry package, so no personal publishing token exists; the release signing key is held in the organisation password manager and is recoverable, with its public half in `allowed_signers`; the release procedure is written down (`GOVERNANCE.md#project-continuity`, `SECURITY.md`); and a second person (`ceoofcyber`) holds write access and code-owner review rights. URL: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#project-continuity`.
bus_factor_justification: Two people can review and merge (`vstantch`, `ceoofcyber`, both code owners); repository, signing key and release flow are organisation-held and documented. See `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#project-continuity`.
documentation_roadmap_justification: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury#roadmap-next-12-months` — now (design-partner selection, deciding Proposed ADRs 0005–0008), next (Phase 1 live I/O shims against a partner stack, first live close), later (enclave xpub derivation, auditor UX, Phase 2 provenance and SOC 2).
documentation_architecture_justification: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md` — claim-layer model, crate layering, close pipeline, I/O seams, trust boundaries; linked from the README.
documentation_security_justification: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/SECURITY.md` (controls, reporting), `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md` (STRIDE per boundary, operator in scope), `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md` (assurance case).
documentation_quick_start_justification: README "Development" section: clone, then `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy …`, `cargo test --workspace` with the pinned toolchain; `docs/auditor-evidence-guide.md` is the quick start for auditors reproducing a close.
documentation_current_justification: Docs are updated in the same PR as the code they describe (`PRESIDIO-REQ.md` delivery status, `CHANGELOG.md` per version, ADRs).
documentation_achievements_justification: The OpenSSF Best Practices badge is displayed and hyperlinked on the README front page (added with the badge id after registration).
maintenance_or_update_justification: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions` states which line is supported; `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/SEMVER.md` documents the upgrade path and what counts as a breaking change.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability` — reporters are credited by name in the published advisory and the CHANGELOG entry unless they request anonymity.
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability` — private GitHub Security Advisory intake, acknowledgement within 72 hours, fix target 30 days.
test_policy_mandated_justification: Formal written policy at `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests`: functionality changes ship with tests; bug fixes include a regression test. Enforced in review and by the coverage gate.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs the full suite on every push and PR with the pinned toolchain, including the `treasury-conformance` contract suites and the `treasury-e2e` whole-close determinism test.
regression_tests_added50_justification: Policy requires a regression test with every bug fix. In the last 6 months no product-code defect fix has been merged (the `fix` commits concern CI configuration); development has been test-first, e.g. PR #34 added adversarial fixtures proving each conformance suite rejects a violating implementation.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: CI gate `cargo llvm-cov --workspace --all-features --fail-under-lines 90` (`coverage` job, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`); measured 93.8% lines on 2026-10-25.
coding_standards_justification: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#style` — rustfmt and clippy, configured in `Cargo.toml` `[workspace.lints]` and `rust-toolchain.toml`.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: `cargo fmt --all --check` and clippy run in CI on every PR and are required checks.
installation_common_justification: Consumed as a Cargo git dependency, e.g. `treasury-core = { git = "https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury", tag = "v0.22.0" }`; built with `cargo build`.
installation_development_quick_justifica: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#local-verification` — clone and run the four cargo commands; `rustup` installs the pinned toolchain automatically.
build_repeatable_justification: `Cargo.lock` is committed, the toolchain is pinned (`rust-toolchain.toml`, 1.88.0), crates come only from crates.io (`cargo-deny` sources check), Actions are SHA-pinned and the Docker base image is digest-pinned, so a rebuild resolves the same sources. Bit-for-bit reproducible builds are not claimed (REQ-33, Phase 2).
build_standard_variables_justification: Built with plain `cargo`; there are no `build.rs` scripts and no hard-coded compiler or linker flags, so `RUSTFLAGS`, `CC` and `CARGO_*` variables pass through unchanged.
build_preserve_debug_justification: Debug information is controlled by standard Cargo profiles; nothing strips it (no `strip` setting; `[profile.release]` only enables `overflow-checks`).
build_non_recursive_justification: A single Cargo workspace build; no recursive make or subdirectory builds.
installation_standard_variables_justific: The workspace is a set of libraries consumed through Cargo; there is no install step to which `DESTDIR`-style conventions apply.
external_dependencies_justification: Listed machine-readably in `Cargo.toml` (`[workspace.dependencies]` and each crate's manifest) and pinned in `Cargo.lock`.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: All reused components are crates.io packages managed by Cargo (no vendored copies); Dependabot tracks Cargo, Actions and Docker updates.
interfaces_current_justification: Dependencies are kept current by Dependabot (e.g. `thiserror` 2.0.21, `sha2` 0.11); `cargo-deny` rejects yanked crates; deprecation warnings fail clippy.
assurance_case_justification: URL: `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md`. Threat model, trust boundaries (B1–B7), secure-design argument and common-weakness argument, built on `docs/threat-model.md`.
implement_secure_design_justification: Fail-safe: every gate fails closed (unassessed assets, missing prices, divergence all block). Complete mediation: canonicalization and append-time provenance checks are the only path into the ledger; logs replay-verify on open. Least privilege: no keys or network in the core. Defence in depth: hash chain + external anchoring + dual control. Economy of mechanism: one encoding, one hash (SHA-256 via `sha2`), unconstructible invalid states. See `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md#3-secure-design-principles-applied`.
input_validation_justification: Data crossing the untrusted-input boundary is validated before use: `treasury_evidence::canonical_bytes` rejects any non-integer number and nesting beyond 128 levels before anything is hashed or booked; the egress allowlist admits only exact endpoint/method matches; chain history is admitted only when two independent sources agree. See `ARCHITECTURE.md#trust-boundaries`.
hardening_justification: `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` workspace-wide; strict clippy deny-list; `overflow-checks = true` in release; SHA-pinned GitHub Actions with least-privilege `permissions:`; digest-pinned Docker base image; `cargo-deny` registry pinning and license allowlist; secret scanning with push protection.
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: The project negotiates no algorithms. SHA-256 is fixed by the content-addressing format; migrating it would be a versioned, breaking format change with new golden vectors (`SEMVER.md#schemawire-stability`), not a runtime switch.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: The project stores and uses no keys or credentials.
crypto_used_network_justification: The project makes no network calls; live I/O shims are out of tree (Phase 1).
signed_releases_justification: Releases are SSH-signed git tags; the first is `v0.22.0` (`https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/releases/tag/v0.22.0`), Verified on GitHub and verifiable offline with `allowed_signers` as documented at `https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-treasury/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases-and-obtaining-public-signing-keys`. The project ships source only; there are no separate binary artifacts to sign.
version_tags_signed_justification: Every release tag is SSH-signed with the org release key (`v0.22.0` onward; earlier versions were never tagged). `git tag -v v0.22.0` with `allowed_signers` checks it.
sites_password_security_justification: The project runs no site that stores passwords.
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot (Cargo, Actions, Docker) and Dependabot security updates; `cargo-deny check all` against the RustSec advisory database on every PR; OpenSSF Scorecard weekly.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: A library workspace with no graphical or end-user UI (the auditor-facing UX is Phase 1 and not in this repository).
